text: ポッポも　コラッタも　かわいー　あたし　まよっちゃう！

structure.jp: ポッポも　コラッタも　かわいー
structure.en: Pidgey and Rattata are both cute

structure.jp: あたし　まよっちゃう！

patterns.name: 〜も〜も
patterns.span: ポッポも　コラッタも
patterns.explanation: も after each of two things means 'both this and that'. ポッポも コラッタも = 'both Pidgey and Rattata'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう says something happens whether you want it or not; ちゃう is its casual short form. まよっちゃう = 'I end up unable to decide'.
